title: Normalized interface for strict tower compact support
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E/Q_ell. Set R_n=O_E/ell^(n+1), with the actual quotient maps, and B_n,T the constant ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site. Define S(T) as the existing category of strict semilinear module systems and D(T) as its ordinary unbounded derived category, with exact ordinary and derived evaluations. Base records the ramification equation, ideal equality, finiteness, the section-preserving presentation of coefficient towers, the existing semilinear derived calculus, and K-injective resolutions. Geometry records the fixed constant-coefficient coordinates of that calculus, retaining ordinary and derived adjunctions and their normalized evaluation equations. Open records the exact ordinary extension by zero with its normalized adjunction. Operations collects geometric operations, termwise composition and the open tensor mate; OpenExchange records the open base-change isomorphism fixed by its inverse adjunction mate. Define compactification F=Rp_* j_!, its proper-counit/open-tensor projection, its proper-square/open-mate exchange, and its finite evaluation isomorphism. Origin retains one bounded-below etale antecedent at a finite level. GoodLevel is the published finite-Tor constructibility predicate after canonical quotient-ideal equality transport. LocalizationData records the exact closed pushforward and the counit-unit distinguished triangle with evaluated boundary. Laws collects boundedness, the finite-field projection claim with both GoodLevel hypotheses, arbitrary-base exchange on level origins, localization, and unbounded joint detection of isomorphisms. The level coordinate normalization identifies the dependent package of the two ordinary functors and their adjunction with the canonical constant-ring package, not just the adjunction values in isolation. The remaining interfaces are the existing ones extracted from SmoothPurityTowerShriekLevels.

Identifying adjunction values does not identify their type parameters; bundle both functors with the ordinary adjunction so projection and dependent elimination provide the required coordinate transport. No evaluation equation is added as an assumption. The original constant-section normalization intent is retained. See coord/changes/C4-tower-level-adjunction-coordinates.md.
